CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.user_has_gym_role(p_gym_id uuid, p_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    select exists (
        select 1
        from public.gym_users gu
        where gu.user_id = (select auth.uid())
          and gu.gym_id = p_gym_id
          and gu.role = any(p_roles)
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_audit_logs(p_gym_id uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 200, p_action text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
    v_result jsonb;
begin
    if not private.user_has_gym_role(
        p_gym_id,
        array['admin']::text[]
    ) then
        raise exception 'La auditoría es exclusiva del administrador.'
            using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    select coalesce(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', recent.id,
                'actor_user_id', recent.actor_user_id,
                'actor_email', recent.actor_email,
                'actor_role', recent.actor_role,
                'action', recent.action,
                'entity_type', recent.entity_type,
                'entity_id', recent.entity_id,
                'summary', recent.summary,
                'details', recent.details,
                'created_at', recent.created_at
            )
            order by recent.created_at desc, recent.id desc
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    )
    into v_result
    from (
        select al.*
        from public.audit_logs al
        where al.gym_id = p_gym_id
          and (
              trim(coalesce(p_action, '')) = ''
              or al.action = trim(p_action)
          )
        order by al.created_at desc, al.id desc
        limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 200), 1), 500)
    ) recent;

    return v_result;
end;
$function$
